findings.description: Cluster-D 'setup-boundary graceful skip' (Option A) is not implementable as written. Integration test files read the env at module load (currentIntegrationEnv.ts:8-13 getIntegrationEnv() throws 'No active integration environment'; daemon.integration.test.ts:57 calls it top-level), so a no-op setup still hard-fails before any describe.skipIf. Flagged High by all 3 reviewers (codex, claude, copilot).
findings.resolution: Pivoted the plan to Option B: config-level project gating in vitest.config.ts (integration projects included only when RUN_INTEGRATION==='1'). No integration test content is edited; the module-load throw is avoided because the integration projects are simply absent from the default run.

findings.description: daemon.integration.test.ts:244 describe('Daemon Fan-Out Integration') has NO skipIf gate. A graceful setup would make it RUN and error in its own beforeAll (a test-level ERROR, not a skip), contradicting AC6 ('report skipped not errored') and Out-of-Scope ('do not change integration test content').
findings.resolution: Option B excludes the entire integration-authenticated project (and the other 4) from the default run, so the ungated Fan-Out block never runs by default and there is no AC6/Out-of-Scope contradiction.

findings.description: The cluster-D file list omitted the integration consumers (currentIntegrationEnv.ts and the top-level-reading integration files) needed for an Option-A skip; without an env-availability flag wired into them, the default run cannot report clean skips. (codex + copilot, High.)
findings.resolution: Option B avoids needing those edits entirely. currentIntegrationEnv.ts is now listed as a read-only reference explaining WHY setup-gating fails; the only cluster-D edit is vitest.config.ts project gating.

findings.description: Risk Areas flags sessionScanner dedup + codexCommand as possible real product regressions, but AC4 only required 'green', letting an impl rewrite the 'length 3 vs 2' assertion to green and mask a genuine regression (the AC3 drift-vs-product safeguard was not applied to AC4).
findings.resolution: AC4 (and US-003) now require a one-line drift-vs-product verdict for sessionScanner and codexCommand, matching the AC3 safeguard.

findings.description: AC6 was not specific enough and conflicted with the code shape; it didn't state how an unavailable integration environment is represented or which suites skip.
findings.resolution: AC6 rewritten concretely for Option B: vitest.config.ts gates the 5 integration projects on RUN_INTEGRATION==='1'; verify (a) default run = unit-only + exit 0, (b) RUN_INTEGRATION=1 still includes them. No integration file edited.

findings.description: Plan required recording re-baseline + apiSession classification notes 'in the job dir' without naming files, hurting autonomous reproducibility.
findings.resolution: Named durable paths: isolated-baseline.out, rebaseline-clusters.md (AC1), apiSession-triage.md (AC3).

findings.description: AC9 ('no previously-passing test broken') could be satisfied while newly-skipped tests hide previously-passing cases; needed a machine-readable before/after comparison.
findings.resolution: AC1 now produces a machine-readable before-list and AC9 compares the final skipped set against it (every newly-skipped test must be accounted for in the AC8 table).

findings.description: US-000 was 'mandatory first' but grouped in phase 1 with Depends on: None, so a parallel runner could start fixes before the baseline capture.
findings.resolution: US-000 is now its own Phase 0 cluster (rebaseline); every other cluster declares dependsOn rebaseline.

findings.description: Editing repo-root environments/environments.ts for quarantine is probably unnecessary and risky (shared by other consumers).
findings.resolution: Option B does not touch environments.ts; it is now a read-only reference. Out-of-Scope explicitly excludes editing it unless Story 0 confirms a genuine migration bug (then surface to lead).

findings.description: AC5 used subjective language ('genuinely environment/timing-bound') with no required evidence.
findings.resolution: AC5 now requires concrete evidence for any skipIf: isolated-run output showing the timeout, a stated reason a deterministic fix is impractical, and the exact skip condition.

findings.description: AC8 said the skip count must be 'small' with no threshold.
findings.resolution: AC8 now caps unit-level quarantine skips at <= 5 and requires the count to equal the number of rows in the AGENTS.md skip-list table.

findings.description: AC7 ('pnpm --filter happy test exits 0') was not anchored to an unloaded condition, so its pass/fail depends on machine load — exactly the confound the LOAD CAVEAT/AC1 call out.
findings.resolution: AC7 now requires the same unloaded condition as AC1.

findings.description: Option A forces fragile setup-gating + the ungated-Fan-Out problem; Option B (unit hard gate, integration opt-in) is simpler and mirrors CI (which never runs vitest).
findings.resolution: Adopted Option B as the primary acceptance signal; Option A retained only as a documented heavier follow-up in Open Questions.

findings.description: AC1 needed a deterministic record path and objective criteria for deciding whether C/D persisted vs load noise.
findings.resolution: AC1 names the artifact path and requires an explicit per-cluster persistence record; a persisting cluster-D failure is recorded as a confirmed prerequisite gap.

findings.description: Labeling cluster D as a 'load artifact' is weaker than for cluster C; status null from migrate is at least as consistent with a missing DB/toolchain prerequisite.
findings.resolution: LOAD CAVEAT amended with the reviewer note; AC1 records a persisting isolated D-failure as a confirmed prerequisite gap (not load).
